CapturePrompt: Press a key (with modifiers) or click a mouse button…
ConnectionTimeout: The driver is not responding. Make sure OpenTabletDriver.Daemon is running and no other tablet driver is open.
DropZip: You can also drop a plugin .zip onto this window.
GuideText:
1. Plug in your tablet and press "Detect tablets".
2. Output: drag the tablet and screen areas or type exact numbers.
3. Filters: enable smoothing plugins if you need them.
4. Bindings: assign the pen tip and buttons (for osu!: Z/X or left click).
5. Press Apply to try the settings, Save to keep them.
InstallFailed: Plugin installation failed. See the console for details.
InstallUpdate: Version {0} is available. Install it now?
InvalidArea: The tablet area is empty (0×0). Save anyway?
InvalidFile: This file is not a valid settings file.
MissingReport: Choose an interface and report type and enter data.
NoPlugins: No plugins of this kind are installed.
NoTablet: No tablet detected. Plug it in and press "Detect tablets".
ReadDFU: Also read Wacom DFU string (may reboot some tablets)
ResetConfirm: Reset all settings to defaults? This cannot be undone.
UpdateAvailable: FrostTablet {0} is available. Open the download page?
DbgWaiting: Move the pen over the tablet
RecordHint: Saves every report to a file for bug reports
ResetChangesTip: Go back to the saved settings
ApplyTip: Try the changes now. They are lost when the driver restarts
ChangesEditedHint: Apply to try them, save to keep them
ChangesAppliedHint: The driver uses them now, but after a restart the saved settings come back
ForeignDaemonHint: Connected to {0}. Close it and restart this app
EmptyToolsBody: Tools are plugins that run in the background while the driver works
EmptyFiltersBody: Filters smooth or reshape pen movement, like Radial Follow or Antichatter
FooterHint: Apply tries the settings, save keeps them
ModeHint: Absolute maps the area to the screen, relative moves like a mouse
ClipHint: Pen positions outside the area stick to its edge
LimitHint: Input outside the area is dropped
UsableTablet: Keep tablet area on the surface
UsableDisplay: Keep screen area on the displays
ConvertHint: Enter the area from another driver
TipHint: For osu!: a key like Z or the left mouse button
ThresholdHint: Pressure needed before the tip counts as pressed
DisablePenButtonsHint: Barrel buttons do nothing, their bindings are kept
DragBindingsHint: Pen buttons only work while the tip touches the tablet
PenDataHint: Turn off what your apps should not receive
DisplayAreaHint: Where the tablet area lands on your screens. Desktop: {0}. Drag the rectangle or type values.
TabletAreaHint: The part of the tablet surface you use. Active surface: {0}.
